page.overview:
What is Alvaro?

Alvaro is a twelfth generation Banu Haqim and a faithful member of the Reformed Evangelical Church of the Redeemer. He was the one to discover the effigy holding the Redeemer.

Alvaro is a man appearing in his mid-30s, and like the other cultists, dresses in white robes over plain dark pants and a white shirt. He's got short cropped black hair and a thin mustache.
